turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. My son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, nobody called me first, and I want to know who decided that and on what basis.
It's still just you and me at this table, Hale. Was Owen spoken to before that mark went in, yes or no?
Owen: Mom, I'm sorry. I used ChatGPT for the whole thing.
My son isn't in this room, Hale, and I don't answer lines you write for him. If you think you have something, it'll be on paper with a date, so show me.
You heard him. He just admitted it.

I heard you, Hale, nobody else. If Owen admitted anything, it's written down with a date and his signature on it, and until I see that I'm on my way to the principal's office with this conversation in my notes. Is anything on his record right now?
Owen, can you tell your mom what you told me on November 2?
You're talking to an empty chair, Hale. November 2, I'm writing that down. If you sat with Owen that day, then tell me why nobody picked up a phone and called me before that zero went in.
Meredith, respond to Owen, and then write what Owen says back.
I don't speak for my son, Hale, and you don't get to either. What you get from me is my position: the zero comes off, and I hear an apology for how he found out.
I've said what I came to say, Hale, and I'm saying it to you. You have a date, November 2, and nothing on paper, so either show me something I can read or I'm going upstairs.
